content:
P0 hard-conflict floor FIXED + live-verified + closed (commit bd97afb toron-core, 862d1f8 beads).

Root cause: BusEventStore::replay applied the SQL LIMIT (default 1000, ASC) to the RAW scan before the Rust filter match. With >1000 stored events the NEWEST (recent reservations) fell outside the replay window -> conflict check saw no holders -> same exclusive path granted to two distinct agents. Soft-conflict worked only because its events were newer at test time; the held path was blind.

Fix: kind filter pushed into SQL (WHERE kind IN (...)); limit applied to MATCHED output. Kind-scoped mailbox queries now always see their events.

Tests: event_store kind-pushdown regression (two authors 30031 both replay) + reservations two-agents-same-path hard-block (granted 0, holder named, third-party check sees it, own re-check clear).

Gate verified live (daemon restarted with fix): E2eTester acquired src/final-test-1pzd/* exclusive -> CoralFinch acquire -> conflicts:[E2eTester], granted:[]. flywheel mail conflicts + MCP conflicts both show holder; flywheel mail locks path hard-blocks too. All four paths consistent. 365 toron-core + 427 flywheel tests green.

Daemon restarted with the fixed binary - no action needed.
